tahajjud.summary: Sallar Isha'i da aka yi a cikin ukun karshe na dare, kafin Asuba.
tahajjud.why: Allah descends   lowest headan donde  last third   night da asks who will call upon Him.  Prophet ﷺ regularly prwataed at night edan when isteğe bağlı don him.
tahajjud.benefits: Yana kusantar mutum zuwa ga Allah, yana tausasa zuciya, kuma ya kasance dabi'ar salihai a gabaninsa. Lokacin da ake amsa addu'a musamman.

fajr.summary: dawn sallah —  first   fida daily farz prwataers.
fajr.why: Allah commanded establishing sallah at  edges   rana; Fajr marks  start   Muslim rana da was nedar abandoned by  Prophet ﷺ donde congregation ko alone.
fajr.benefits: Duk wanda yayi sallar asuba yana cikin tsarin Allah. Mala'ikun dare da yini sun yi shaida kuma yana kawo haske ga sauran yini.

sunrise.summary: Lokacin da rana ta fito sama da sararin sama - alamar lokaci, ba addu'a kanta ba.
sunrise.why: An hana yin addu'a yayin fitowar rana (da kuma a lokacin zenith da faɗuwa) don haka al'umma ba ta kama da masu bautar rana. Sanin fitowar rana yana taimakawa lokacin Ishraki da nisantar lokutan sallah mara inganci.
sunrise.benefits: Observing Allah's signs donde  sky increases awe (taqwa) da helps structure  morning sunnah prwataers correctly.

ishraq.summary: two-rak'ah sunnah sallah after  sun has fully risen (about 15–20 minutes after sunrise).
ishraq.why: Prophet ﷺ said whoedar prwatas Fajr donde congregation then sits remembering Allah until sunrise, then prwatas two rak'ahs, receidas  reward   tamamlandı Hac da 'Umre.
ishraq.benefits: Immense reward tare da minimal effort when combined tare da Fajr donde congregation.  peaceful start   rana donde zikir da isteğe bağlı sallah.

duha.summary: forenoon sallah — typically two  eight rak'ahs between sunrise da Dhuhr.
duha.why: Charity is due on every joint of the body each day; even a few rak'ahs of Duha fulfills that charity for the limbs through worship.
duha.benefits: Forgives sins, brings sustenance (rizq), and revives a neglected sunnah. Flexible timintig makes it accessible when the day allows.

dhuhr.summary: middwata sallah —  second farz sallah, when  sun passes its zenith.
dhuhr.why: fida daily prwataers were made farz   Night Tafiya; Dhuhr breaks  dwata's busyness tare da remembrance  Allah.
dhuhr.benefits: Annabi SAW ya ce farkon aikin da za a yi hukunci a ranar kiyama ita ce sallah. Kiyaye Zuhur yana kare sauran ayyukan mutum.

asr.summary: afternoon sallah —  middle sallah emphasized donde  Alkur'ani.
asr.why: Allah ya yi gargadi musamman game da kiyaye sallar tsakiyar (Sallar Wusta). Yana faɗuwa lokacin da mutane da yawa suka shagaltu ko sun gaji, don haka kiyaye shi alama ce ta ikhlasi.
asr.benefits: Duk wanda ya rasa Asuba, kamar ya yi hasarar iyalansa da dukiyarsa - yana nuna nauyinsa. Rike shi yana ƙarfafa horo a cikin yini.

maghrib.summary: sunset sallah — prwataed immediately after  sun has wataarla.
maghrib.why: time opens right at sunset; delwataing without reason risks missing  preferred window.  Prophet ﷺ warned against neglecting sallah until  sun has wataarla.
maghrib.benefits: Marks gratitude at  dwata's end da was among  first prwataers  Prophet ﷺ emphasized  his companions.

isha.summary: night sallah —  last   fida farz prwataers, after twilight fades.
isha.why: Yana kammala zagayowar ibadar yau da kullum. Manzon Allah Sallallahu Alaihi Wasallama ya ce idan mutum ya yi Isha’i a cikin jam’i, kamar ya yi rabin dare ne.
isha.benefits: Yana kawo natsuwa kafin barci kuma yana cika sallar farilla. Sau da yawa ana bin Witr, wato sunnah mu'akkadah.

witr.summary: Sallah mara adadi (yawanci raka'a daya ko uku) bayan Isha'i kafin asuba - sunnah mu'akkadah, ba daya daga cikin sallolin farida biyar ba.
witr.why: The Prophet ﷺ said Allah is Witr (Kunnae) and loves Witr, so maintain the Witr prayer. He never abandoned it, even when traveling.
witr.benefits: distinctida mark   beliedar's night routine. Closing  rana tare da odd-numbered sallah aligns tare da Allah's isimler da  Prophet's istikrarlı pratik.

tahiyyatul_masjid.summary: Raka'a biyu suna gaisawa da masallaci lokacin shiga, kafin a zauna.
tahiyyatul_masjid.why: Idan dayanku ya shiga masallaci sai ya sallaci raka'a biyu kafin ya zauna, umarnin Annabi SAW kai tsaye.
tahiyyatul_masjid.benefits: Honors  house  Allah, prepares  heart don congregation ko private ibadet, da replaces idle sitting tare da immediate good.

hajat_istikhara.summary: Isteğe bağlı prwataers don personal needs (Salat al-Hajah) da seeking Allah's guidance (Salat al-Istikhara).
hajat_istikhara.why: Istikhara shine ka roki Allah ya zaba maka alheri yayin fuskantar hukunci. Haja ita ce gabatar da buqatar mutum ga Allah ta hanyar addu'a kafin addu'a ko tare da ita.
hajat_istikhara.benefits: Wannanilds reliance  Allah (tawakkul) instead  anxiety alone. Istikhara brings clarity; Hajah pairs ibadet tare da sincere request — da Allah answers those who call upon Him.

witrNote.title: Ana buƙatar Witr qaza?
witrNote.intro: A cewar mafi rinjayen malamai, yin Witr da aka rasa yana halatta, amma ko ana bukata ya dogara da mazhabar ku (makarantar tunani).
witrNote.hanafiBody: Witiri wajibi ne (wajibi). Idan kun rasa shi, dole ne ku gyara shi (qaza). Yi addu'a da zarar kun tuna - ko da kwanaki ko makonni sun shude. Wannan shi ne ra'ayin da mafi yawan Musulmi a Kudancin Asiya, Asiya ta Tsakiya, da Turkiyya ke bi.
witrNote.othersBody: Witr sunnah ce mai karfi da aka jaddada (sunnah mu'akkadah), ba wajibi ba. Ana so a yi shi (mustahabbi) amma ba a bukata ba. Annabi SAW yana rama sallolin dare da aka rasa saboda barci ko rashin lafiya.
witrNote.evidenceBody: Annabi ﷺ yana cewa: "Duk wanda ya kwana ya rasa Witiri ko ya manta, to ya yi sallah idan ya tuna". (Tirmizi, Ibn Majah — malamai sun yi sabani a kan darajarta.) A cikin Sahihu Muslim, idan ya bar sallar dare saboda rashin lafiya ko barci, sai ya rama ta da rana da adadin raka’o’i.
witrNote.footer: Wannan app ɗin yana ƙididdige Witr da aka rasa zuwa qaza ga duk masu amfani. Ku bi shi kamar yadda ake buƙata idan kun bi ra'ayin Hanafiyya; in ba haka ba bi shi a matsayin shawarar kayan shafa. Tuntuɓi malami don halin ku.

travel.subtitle: Qasr, Jam', da what  Alkur'ani da Sunnah teach about salah   yolculuk
travel.takeaway: Allah legislated shortening (Qasr) da combining (Jam') out  mercy don  tradaller — not  abandon sallah, but  ease its performance   road.
travel.obligationsTitle: Abin da har yanzu kuke da alhakin
travel.rakatsNote: Kunnaly the fard is shown. Sunnah rawatib and Witr are discussed below — they remain recommended, though many travellers lighten them for hardship.

quran.excerpt: When you travel through the land, there is no blame on you if you shorten the prayer, if you fear that those who disbelieve may harm you. Indeed, the disbelievers are ever a clear enemy to you.

hadith.excerpt: Anas said: We tradalled tare da  Messenger  Allah ﷺ.  mu'adhin called don sallah da he said: 'Prwata two rakahs' — da he did  same don  other prwataers except Maghrib (three) da Fajr (two).
Ibn Abbas said:  Prophet ﷺ combined Dhuhr da Asr, da Maghrib da Isha donde Madinah without fear ko rain. When asked why, he said: 'He wanted not  burden his Ummah.'

Ya'la ibn Umayyah said: I said to Umar ibn al-Khattab: 'There is no sin if one shortens the prayer while travelling.' Umar replied: 'I wondered the same, so I asked the Prophet ﷺ and he said: It is charity from Allah — accept His charity.'
Prophet ﷺ said: 'Allah lodas şu His concessions be taken, just as He hates  be disobeyed.'

obligations: fida daily prwataers remain farz — shortened (Qasr) when siz qualify as  tradaller.
Fajr (two rakahs) and Maghrib (three rakahs) are never shortened.
Ku mwata combine Dhuhr tare da Asr, da Maghrib tare da Isha, when  conditions  seyahat uygula.
Each shortened prayer is prayed like the first two rakahs of the full prayer — recite Al-Fatiha and a surah, bow, prostrate, then sit for tashahhud and salam.
When siz return ana swatafa ko intend  settle, resume prwataing each sallah donde full at its proper time.
Kaçırıldı prwataers whtare da tradalling must still be made up (kaza) — seyahat does not waida what was omitted.

qasr.title: Qasr - ragewa
qasr.body: Sallar farida raka'a hudu - Zuhr, Asr, da Isha - ana yin su ne a matsayin raka'a biyu a kan tafiya ta cancanta. Yi musu addu'a daidai da raka'o'i biyu na farko a gida: karatun tsayuwa, ruku'u daya, sujudi biyu, tashahhud, sallama. Fajr ya tsaya raka'a biyu, Maghrib kuma ya tsaya uku; ba a taqaice ba. QAsr ya shafi fard kawai.

jam.title: Jam' - hadawa
jam.body: tradaller mwata combine Dhuhr tare da Asr into one sitting, da Maghrib tare da Isha into one sitting — prwataing both fard prwataers geri--geri tare da one ezan da iqamah. Fajr cannot be combined tare da any other sallah. Combining dir  separate concession den shortening: siz mwata shorten without combining, combine without shortening (donde some situations), ko do both together.

jamTypes.title: Jam' al-Taqdim & al-Ta'khir
jamTypes.body: Jam' al-Taqdim (early combining): prwata both prwataers together at  earlier prwataer's time — e.g. Dhuhr da Asr at Dhuhr time. Jam' al-Ta'khir (gecikti combining): prwata both at  later prwataer's time — e.g. Dhuhr da Asr at Asr time.  Prophet ﷺ combined at Nemofah (Dhuhr at Asr time) da at Muzdalifah (Maghrib at Isha time), establishing both forms.

when.title: Lokacin farawa & ƙarewa
when.body: Concessions begin once you leave your town or city on a journey — not for daily commutes within your locality. They end when you return home, or when you intend to stay at your destination for the period scholars define as 'settling' (the number of days differs between schools). If you are unsure whether you still count as a traveller, ask a scholar before assumintig the concessions.

distance.title: Tafiya distance
distance.body: Most scholars require a mintiimum travel distance before Qasr and Jam' apply — commonly cited as roughly 80 km (48 miles), or about two days' journey on foot. Some schools measure from the last buildings of one's city; others use a shorter threshold. The app does not calculate this for you — know your school's criterion and apply it with a scholar's guidance.

sunnah.title: Sunnah prwataers whtare da tradalling
sunnah.body: Sallar sunna da aka jaddada (rawatib) gabanin farida da bayanta suna nan suna da kyau amma ba a bukata. Malamai da yawa suna halatta barinsu yayin tafiya saboda wahala, musamman idan aka hada sallah. Gaisuwar masallacin (tahiyatul masjid) da sauran sallolin nafila sun kasance halal ne a duk lokacin da kuka samu lokaci da kuzari.

witr.title: Witr   yolculuk
witr.body: Witr sunna ce mu'akkadah (karfin jaddadawa) kuma kada a bar shi yayin tafiya. Yi Sallah bayan Isha'i - ko da kun haɗa Maghrib da Isha - a matsayin raka'a ɗaya, uku, ko fiye gwargwadon abin da za ku iya sarrafa. Idan kun ji tsoron yin barci kafin Isha'i yayin tafiya, Manzon Allah SAW ya halatta yin sallar witiri tun da farko bayan Magariba Isha'i.

travel.disclaimer: Wannan abun ciki ne na ilimi, ba fatawar mutum ba. Matsakaicin nisa, lokacin tsayawa, hada dokoki, da kuma ko Jam' ta iyakance ga buƙata sun bambanta tsakanin makarantu huɗu - tuntuɓi ƙwararren malami don tafiyarku.

hayd.title: Hayd & ibada
hayd.subtitle: Abin da nassosi suka koyar game da haila da ayyukan ibada na yau da kullum
hayd.obligationsTitle: Abin da har yanzu kuke da alhakin

hadith.excerpt: Aisha said:  Messenger  Allah ﷺ said  me: 'When sizin menses ends, perform ghusl da then prwata.'
The Prophet ﷺ said: 'Is it not the case that when one of you menstruates, she neither prays nor fasts?'

obligations: Do not offer salah while in hayd — this is Allah's concession, not neglect of worship.
Do not oruç during hwataız; any kaçırıldı Ramadan fasts must be made up afterward.
Ku mwata still make zikir, dua, listen  Alkur'ani, gida charity, da other good deeds.
When hwataız ends, perform ghusl da resume salah da oruç.

duration.title: Duration of hayd
duration.body:
Hayd shine zubar jini na yau da kullun na wata-wata da yawancin mata ke fuskanta a daidai lokacin da aka saba kowace zagaye. Masana sun tattauna mafi ƙarancin lokacin (wasu sun ce yini ɗaya da dare, wasu suna buƙatar ƙarin) da matsakaicin tsawon lokaci - alkalumman da aka ambata sun bambanta daga kusan kwanaki 10 zuwa 15 dangane da mazhabar tunani.

A zahiri, lura da tsarin ku na yau da kullun ('ada): kwanaki nawa Hayd yakan wuce da kuma lokacin da yakan fara. Idan jini ya ci gaba da wuce iyakar Hayd a makarantarku, za a iya ɗaukar karin kwanakin a matsayin istihada - hukunce-hukuncen sallah da azumi suna canzawa da zarar Haydi ya ƙare, ko da jinin ya ci gaba.

istihada.title: Istihada - zubar da jini na yau da kullun
istihada.body:
Istihada yana zubar da jini a wajen lokacin haid na al'ada - tsakanin hawan keke, bayan balaga kafin lokacin farko na al'ada, ko kuma lokacin da jini ya ci gaba da wuce iyakar hayd.

Ba kamar hayd ba, Istihada baya sauke wajibcin sallah da azumi. Mace mai istihadi gaba xaya ta yi alwala ga kowace sallah alhalin jini yana aiki; Shi kansa jinin ba ya warware alwala a cewar malamai da dama.

Bambance hayd da Istihada na iya zama da wahala. Mata masu zagayowar da aka sani sukan dogara ga al'adarsu, lokacin wata, da halayen jini. Idan ba ku da tabbas ko zubar jini hayid ne ko Istihada, dakatar da bin diddigin wajibi ne kawai idan kun tabbata hayid ne, kuma ku tuntubi ƙwararren malami don takamaiman lamarinku.

nifas.title: Nifas - zubar jini bayan haihuwa
nifas.body:
Nifas yana zubar da jini bayan haihuwa. Haka faffadan ka'idojin hayd: ba a yin sallah da azumi a cikin Nifas, kuma azumin Ramadan da aka rasa ana yin sa ne daga baya - ba sallah ba.

Matsakaicin tsawon lokaci ya bambanta da makaranta; Ana yawan ambaton kwanaki 40. Idan Nifas ta kare, sai a yi tawassuli kuma a ci gaba da ibada. Nifas da hayd nau'i ne daban-daban - mace na iya dandana duka a lokuta daban-daban a rayuwarta.

purity.title: Lokacin da zubar jini ya ƙare - ghusl & sake dawowa
purity.body:
Idan haydi ko nifas ya kare, sai a yi tafsirin gaba daya kafin a ci gaba da sAllah. Ci gaba da azumi bayan an gama hayid; duk wani azumin Ramadan da aka rasa a lokacin haydi dole ne a rama shi a wasu ranaku.

Salatin da aka rasa a lokacin hayd bai cika ba - Allah ya ɗaga wannan wajibi. Wannan ya bambanta da rashin lafiya ko tafiya, inda sallar da ba a yi ba na iya buƙatar qaza. Bayan ghusl, ci gaba da ibadar ku ta al'ada da bin diddigin wajibi a cikin app.

sick.title: Hastalık & sallah
sick.subtitle: Concessions don sickness da what remains upon siz
sick.obligationsTitle: Abin da har yanzu kuke da alhakin

hadith.excerpt: Prophet ﷺ said: 'Prwata standing; if siz cannot, then sitting; if siz cannot, then  sizin side.'
The Prophet ﷺ said: 'Allah has removed from my Ummah mistakes, forgetfulness, and what they are forced to do.'
Imran ibn Huswatan had  painful condition da prwataed sitting.  Prophet ﷺ asked him: 'Can siz stand?' He said no, so  Prophet ﷺ said: 'Then prwata sitting; if siz cannot, then lying  sizin side.'

obligations: If you are able, pray in whatever position you can — standing, sitting, or lying down.
Reduce ko omit bowing da prostration only when siz genuinely cannot perform them.
If you are too ill to pray at all, that prayer is waived — make it up (qaza) when you recover.
Ya rasa Ramadan fasts due to illness should be made up when you are able.
Ku mwata still make zikir, dua, read Alkur'ani, da gida charity.

positions.title: Yin addu'a yayin rashin lafiya - matsayi
positions.body:
Abin da ake so shi ne yin addu'a a tsaye tare da cikakken ruku'u da sujuda. Idan tsaye yana haifar da ciwo mai tsanani, rauni, ko cutarwa, yi addu'a a zaune - malamai da yawa suna ba da izinin zama ko da ba tare da tsayawa da farko ba lokacin da rashin lafiya ke da wuya a tsaye.

Idan ba za ka iya zama a tsaye ba, ka yi addu’a a kwance a gefenka ko bayanka, kana yin ishara da ruku’u da sujuda da kai. Yi amfani da kowane rangwamen matsayi kafin tsallake addu'a gaba ɗaya.

Idan ba za ku iya amfani da ruwa don yin alwala ba saboda rashin lafiya ko haɗarin cutarwa, ku yi taimiyya idan sharuɗɗanta sun cika.

rukuSujud.title: Ruku & sujud tare da limited modament
rukuSujud.body:
When you cannot perform full bowing, incline your head for ruku — a deeper incline for sujud. This is the concession used when praying sitting or lying down.

If you cannot move your head at all, scholars differ on the mintiimum movement required — some allow intention alone in extreme cases, while others require whatever movement is physically possible.

Do not omit an entire prayer if you can pray with reduced movements. The Prophet ﷺ taught us to use concessions step by step rather than abandoning salah.

unable.title: An kammala inability  prwata
unable.body:
If you lose consciousness, fall into deep sleep through a prayer time, or are so severely ill that you cannot pray even with all position concessions — and the entire time for that prayer passes — that prayer is waived with no sin, but must be made up (qaza) when you recover.

Marking a day as excused (illness) in this app pauses obligatory tracking and holds your streak — it does not replace the obligation to make up missed prayers later.

For chronic or long-term illness, learn the fixed concessions that apply to your situation from a qualified scholar rather than assumintig every day is fully waived.

fastingQaza.title: Azumi, recodary & make-up (kaza)
fastingQaza.body:
If fasting in Ramadan would worsen your illness or delay recovery, break the fast and make it up on other days after you recover — the Qur'an explicitly permits this for the ill.

Each missed Ramadan fast is made up with one day of fasting later; there is no kaffarah (expiation) unless the fast was broken without a valid excuse.

Ya rasa salah during illness must also be made up in order once you are able — unlike hayd, where missed prayers are not qaza. When you recover, resume normal tracking and work through your qaza at a sustainable pace.

events.title: Al'amuran Musulunci
events.subtitle: Kwanaki masu zuwa a shekarar Hijira
events.disclaimer: Ana ƙididdige kwanan wata ƙididdiga - ainihin ranar ya dogara da ganin wata na gida.

descriptions.newYear: Farkon watan Muharram yana bude shekarar Hijira (wata), wanda lissafinsa ya fara ne daga hijirar Annabi (Hijira) daga Makka zuwa Madina. Muharram yana daya daga cikin watanni hudu masu alfarma kuma Manzon Allah (SAW) ya kira shi "Watan Allah," ya sanya azumtar sa da mafifici bayan Ramadan (Sahih Muslim 1163). Lokaci ne da za a yi tunani a kan shekarar da ta gabata da sabunta kyakkyawar niyya. Babu takamaiman al'ada da aka wajabta don ranar kanta, don haka ku kiyayi ayyukan "Sabuwar Shekara" marasa tushe; yawaita azumin son rai a duk wata, Sunnah ce tabbatacciya.
descriptions.ashura: 10 ga Muharram. Annabi SAW ya samu Yahudawan Madina suna azumin ta saboda godiya ga Allah ya tseratar da Musa da Bani Isra’ila daga Fir’auna, sai ya ce: “Mu ne mafi cancanta a kan Musa fiye da kai,” sannan ya azumce shi kuma ya ce wa Musulmi su yi azumi (Sahihul Bukhari 2004). Azumin Ashura yana kankare kananan zunubai na shekarar da ta gabata (Sahih Muslim 1162). Don bambanta da sauran al'ummomi, an so a azumci 9 ga (Tasu'a): Annabi SAW ya yi nufin yin haka a shekara mai zuwa (Sahih Muslim 1134). Yin azumi na 9 da 10 tare shi ne abin da aka fi so.
descriptions.mawlid: Ana danganta ranar 12 ga watan Rabi al-Awwal da haifuwar Annabi Muhammad (SAW) (ana tafka muhawara a kai a tsakanin masana tarihi). Musulmai a duniya suna sonsa da girmama shi kuma an umarce su da su yi salati a gare shi (Alkur'ani 33:56). Ko dai gudanar da bukukuwan da aka kebe (Maulidi) wani lamari ne da manyan malamai suka sha bamban a kansa: da yawa, musamman a cikin Sufaye da al'adun gargajiya, suna ba da izini ko karfafa taron tunawa da aiko da salloli, yayin da wasu (musamman a cikin al'adar Salafiyya) suna ganin cewa ba a yi kayyade shekara ta al'ummomin farko ba don haka ya kamata a guji. Wannan app yana gabatar da ranar tsaka tsaki; yawaita salawati da bin sunnar Annabi kayan da aka yarda da su ne.
descriptions.isra: Al-Isra wa al-Mi'raj na tunawa da Tafiyar Dare na Annabi SAW daga Makkah zuwa Kudus (al-Aqsa) da hawansa zuwa sama, wanda aka yi nuni a cikin Alkur'ani sura 17:1 da 53. A wannan dare ne aka wajabta salloli biyar - asali hamsin, sannan ya rage zuwa biyar da rahamar Allah Sa'ad-4933 . Dare yana tabbatar da alfarmar al-Aqsa da tsakiyar SAllah. Ƙayyadaddun kwanansa (wanda aka fi sani a ranar 27 ga Rajab) bai tabbata ba, kuma babu wata ibada ta musamman da aka danganta da shi kansa daren; kiyaye salloli biyar shine darasi mai dorewa.
descriptions.ramadan: Wata na tara kuma rukunnan musulunci na hudu. Yin azumi daga fitowar alfijir zuwa faduwar rana wajibi ne a kan kowane musulmi baligi mai ƙwazo (Qur'an 2:183-185). Shi ne watan da aka fara saukar da Alkur'ani a cikinsa (Alkur'ani 2:185). Manzon Allah (S.A.W) ya ce: "Duk wanda ya azumci Ramadan yana mai imani da neman lada, za a gafarta masa abin da ya gabata na zunubansa" (Sahihul Bukhari 38). Ana raya darare da sallar tarawihi, kuma kwanaki goman karshe suna dauke da Lailatul Kadri. Watan azumi ne, da Alkur'ani, da sadaka, da kusanci zuwa ga Allah.
descriptions.laylatQadr: Lailatul kadari — “mafi alheri fiye da watanni dubu” (Qur’an 97:3), daren da Kur’ani ya fara saukowa. Ibada a kai ta fi tsawon rayuwa sama da shekaru tamanin da uku. Manzon Allah (SAW) ya ce: “Duk wanda ya tsaya (a cikin salla) a daren Lailatul Kadri yana mai imani da neman lada, za a gafarta masa abin da ya gabata na zunubansa” (Sahihul Bukhari 1901). Ainihin darensa a ɓoye yake; ku neme shi a cikin dararen goman karshe na Ramadan - na 21, 23, 25, 27, da 29 (Sahihul Bukhari 2017), tare da 27 na musamman fata. Ku ciyar da wadannan dararen a cikin addu'a, da Alkur'ani, da dua: "Allahumma innaka 'afuwwun tuhibbu al-'afwa fa'fu 'anni."
descriptions.eidFitr: Bikin buda baki, a ranar 1 ga watan Shawwal, shi ne karshen watan Ramadan. Ana fara yinin ne da Sallar Idi kuma ana gabatar da zakkat al-Fitr, sadaka da ake bayarwa kafin sallah don haka ma talakawa su yi murna. Musulmai sun yi takbirai, suna sanya mafi kyawu, suna musayar gaisuwa, da karfafa alakar iyali da jama'a. An haramta yin azumi a wannan rana (Sahihul Bukhari 1991) - rana ce ta godiya da halaccin bikin ibadar da aka kammala a watan Ramadan.
descriptions.arafah: 9 ga Zul-Hijja, mafi girman ranar Hajji, lokacin da maHajjata ke tsayuwar ibada a filin Arafah - "Hajji Arafah." Ya zo a cikin kwanaki goma na farkon Zul-Hijja masu albarka, kwanakin da ayyuka na qwarai suka fi soyuwa a cikinsu a wurin Allah fiye da kowa (Sahihul Bukhari 969). Ga wadanda ba su yi aikin Hajji ba, azumin wannan rana yana da mustahabbi: yana kankare zunuban shekarar da ta gabata da kuma shekara mai zuwa (Sahih Muslim 1162). MaHajjata su kansu ba sa azumi, don samun karfin tsayuwa da addu'a.
descriptions.eidAdha: Idin layya a ranar 10 ga watan Zul-Hijja shi ne mafi girma daga cikin idi biyun kuma ya yi daidai da kammala aikin Hajji. Tana tunawa da yarda da Annabi Ibrahim ya yi ya sadaukar da ɗansa don biyayya ga Allah, wanda ya fanshi shi da rago (Alkurani 37:100–107). Masu iya yin hadaya (Udhiyah/Qurbani), raba naman tare da iyali, maƙwabta, da matalauta. Ranar tana farawa ne da sallar idi da takbir kuma tana ci gaba har zuwa kwanaki uku na Tashriq. Haramun ne a wannan rana da ranakun Tashriq (Sahihul Bukhari 1991).

basics.title: Menene zakka?
basics.summary: Rukuni na uku - 2.5% akan dukiyar cancanta
basics.body:
Zakka itace rukunnan musulunci na uku, zama tsakanin sAllah (sAllah) da azumin Ramadan. A cikin Alkur'ani an maimaita umarnin tsai da salla da bayar da zakka a matsayin nau'i-nau'i guda - yana nuna cewa bautar Allah da kula da halittunsa suna sak'a tare. Ba kyauta ba ce, amma tabbataccen haƙƙi na wajibi ne talakawa ke riƙe da dukiyar masu kuɗi.

Kalmar zakka tana nufin tsarkakewa da girma. Bayar da ɗan ƙaramin rabo daga abin da kuka samu yana tsarkake sauran dukiyar ku da zuciyarku daga kwaɗayi, kuma - da alƙawarin Allah - yana sa abin da ya rage ya tsiro a cikin ni'ima maimakon raguwa.

Matsakaicin adadin kuɗin kuɗi shine kashi ɗaya bisa arba'in, wato 2.5%. Don haka duk 1,000 na dukiyar da ta cancanta da ta cika shekararta sama da ƙofa, 25 ya kamata. Wannan ƙaramin rabo ne ta ƙira: isa ya rarraba albarkatu ga mabukata ba tare da takura mai bayarwa ba.

Zakka ba ita ce sadaqah ba. Sadaqah ita ce duk wata sadaka ta son rai, wacce ake bayarwa a kowane adadi, a kowane lokaci, ga kusan kowa. Zakka wani wajibci ne da aka ayyana – kayyade kididdigar, akan nau’ukan dukiya, da zarar an cika sharuddan da aka gindaya, ana biya don tsara nau’ukan mutane. Yin watsi da shi da gangan babban zunubi ne; Alqur’ani da Sunnah sun yi gargaxi da kakkausar murya kan tara dukiya tare da tauye haqqinta.

purpose.title: Me ya sa zakka - manufa & hikima
purpose.summary: Yana tsarkake dukiya da rai, kuma yana dagawa talaka
purpose.body:
Allah yana cewa game da zakka: "Ka karvi sadaka daga dukiyoyinsu, kana tsarkake su da ita, kuma ka tsirar da su" (k:9:103). Wajibi yana aiki a matakai biyu lokaci guda - yana tsarkake ran mai bayarwa daga rowa da son duniya, kuma yana tsarkake dukiyar da kanta ta yadda abin da ke hannunka ya zama mai kyau da albarka.

A zamantakewa, zakka tsari ne da Allah ya yi umarni da shi na yawo. A lokacin da Annabi SAW ya aika Mu'az zuwa Yaman ya yi umarni da a karbo zakka daga mawadatansu a ba wa talakawansu. Ba a nufin dukiya ta tara a tsakanin ‘yan kaɗan; zakka tana mayar da ita cikin motsi domin a ciyar da mabuqata, a ‘yanta masu bi bashi, a qarfafa dankon al’umma.

A Ruhaniya, bada zakka aikin godiya ne da rikon amana. Yana amsa kwaɗayin ɗan adam don tarawa da haƙƙin cewa tanadi daga Allah yake, kuma yana horar da mumini ga son bayarwa. Wanda ya ba da zakka da son rai ya sami kariya daga dukiyoyinsu, zuciyarsa ta sauƙaƙa, da ladarsu a wurin Ubangijinsu – “babu tsoro a kansu, kuma ba za su yi baƙin ciki ba” (k:2:277).

hawl.title: Shekarar Lunar (Hawl)
hawl.summary: Dole ne dukiya ta kasance sama da nisabi na shekara guda Hijiriyya
hawl.body:
Zakkar tsabar kudi, zinare, azurfa, da dukiyoyin ciniki gaba daya ana bayar da ita ne bayan wannan dukiyar ta kasance a ko sama da matakin nisabi na shekara daya cikakkar Hijira (wata), wanda aka fi sani da halaccin. Annabi ﷺ ya koyar da cewa babu zakka akan dukiya sai shekara ta wuce.

A aikace, lura da ranar da dukiyar ku zakka ta fara kaiwa nisabi. Wannan kwanan wata ita ce ranar zakka ta shekara - kowace shekara, a daidai wannan ranar Hijira, kuna darajar duk abin da kuka mallaka kuma ku biya kashi 2.5% na jimillar.

Ba kwa buƙatar bin kowane tsabar kuɗi daban. Yawancin malamai sun yarda cewa muddin jimlar ku ta kasance a ko sama da nisab a cikin shekara, ƙananan tsomawa da tashi tsakanin ba su da matsala - kawai kuna tantance jimillar jimlar ranar tunawa da ku. Idan dukiyar ku ta faɗi ƙasa da nisab a cikin shekara, malamai da yawa suna la'akari da aikin sake saitawa, sake farawa kawai lokacin da kuka isa nisab.

Ku tuna cewa shekarar Hijira (wata) ta fi ta shekarar rana ta kusan kwana goma sha daya. Idan kun fi son biyan kuɗi akan ƙayyadadden kwanan watan Gregorian don dacewa, wasu malamai suna ba da izini idan kun ƙara ƙimar kuɗi kaɗan don lissafin gajeriyar zagayowar wata. Noma da kiwo suna bin ka'idodin lokacinsu kuma ba a haɗa su da kayan gona kamar yadda suke ba.

nisab.title: Nisab - mafi ƙarancin ƙima
nisab.summary: An auna da ~ 87.5 g zinariya ko ~ 595-612 g azurfa
nisab.body:
Nisab ita ce mafi karancin dukiyar da mutum ya mallaka kafin zakka ta wajaba. Duk wanda dukiyarsa ta tsaya kasa da nisabi duk shekara, ba shi da zakka, wajibi ne a kan wanda yake da ragi na gaske.

Manzon Allah ﷺ ya sanya mashina a cikin kudin zamaninsa: dinari 20 na zinari ko dirhami na azurfa 200. A cikin nauyi wannan yana aiki zuwa kusan 85-87.5 g na zinariya, da kusan 595-612 g na azurfa (ƙananan bambancin yana nuna jujjuyawar malamai daban-daban na dirhami). Wannan kalkuleta yana amfani da adadi mai yawa da aka ambata na kusan 87.48 g zinariya da 612.36 g azurfa.

Domin zinariya da azurfa ba kasuwanci a rabo da suka yi a zamanin Annabi, da biyu kofa yanzu ba da daban-daban monetary dabi'u - da azurfa nisab ne nisa m. Don haka da yawa daga cikin malamai na wannan zamani suna ba da shawarar auna tsabar kudi da gauraya dukiya a kan nisabin azurfa: yana sanya mutane da yawa abin dogaro, amma hakan yana nufin ana taimakon talakawa da yawa, wanda shine ruhin farilla. Wasu kuma suna bin nisabin zinare. Dukansu mukamai ana mutunta su - ku bi jagorar malamin ku.

zakatable.title: Mene ne gaba ɗaya zakka
zakatable.summary: Cash, karafa, saka hannun jari, kayan ciniki, karbuwa
zakatable.body:
Zakka tana kan dukiyar da ke da yuwuwar girma - kuɗi da abubuwan da aka riƙe a matsayin kuɗi - maimakon kan abubuwan da kuke amfani da su kawai. Babban nau'ikan da aka amince da su a fadin makarantun sune tsabar kudi, zinare da azurfa, kayayyakin kasuwanci, da (tare da nasu dokokin) amfanin gona da dabbobi.

Mafi yawan zakka a yau: tsabar kuɗi a hannu da a asusun banki; zinariya da azurfa, ciki har da bullion, tsabar kudi, da kayan ado da aka adana ba a amfani da su akai-akai; hannun jari, hannun jari, da kuɗaɗen haɗin gwiwar da aka ƙima a farashin kasuwarsu na yanzu; kayayyaki da kayan aiki na kasuwanci (kayan ciniki), masu daraja a farashin sake siyarwa; karɓuwa mai ƙarfi - lamuni da daftari da kuke tsammanin tattarawa; da kudin haya ko kasuwancin da kuka ajiye maimakon kashewa.

Malamai da yawa kuma sun haɗa da tanadin yin ritaya mai isa da kuɗaɗe da kuma cryptocurrencies da aka gudanar azaman kadara, suna ɗaukar su kamar kuɗi ko saka hannun jari. Lokacin da ake shakka, tambayar jagora mai sauƙi ce: shin wannan dukiya tana da daraja ko kuma hanyar haɓakawa da zan iya lalatawa? Idan haka ne, mai yiyuwa ne zakka. Kimar komai a farashin kasuwa na yau akan ranar zakka - ba akan abin da kuka fara biya ba.

exempt.title: Abin da yawanci ba zakka ba
exempt.summary: Abubuwan amfani na sirri, kayan ado da aka sawa, kulle-kullen fansho
exempt.body:
Dukiyar da aka daure a rayuwarku ta yau da kullun ba zakka ba ce, domin zakka tana yin ta'ammali da dukiyar ne, ba abubuwan da kuke rayuwa da su da amfani ba. Gidanku, motar ku, tufafinku, kayan daki, kayan aiki, da kayan aiki da kayan aikinku duk an keɓe su - duk da mahimmancin su.

Kayan ado na zinari da azurfa da mace ke sanyawa akai-akai sanannen abu ne na banbanci. Mazhabar Hanafiyya ta ce duk zinare da azurfa zakka ne ko da kuwa an sanya su; Mafi rinjaye - Maliki, Shafi'i, da Hanbali - an keɓance kayan ado na yau da kullun don amfanin kansu amma sun haɗa da su idan an adana su azaman ma'ajin dukiya ko kuma sun wuce kayan ado na al'ada. Ku bi hukuncin makarantar da kuke bi.

Kudaden fansho ko na tanadin da ba za ku iya ba har yanzu ana cire su har sai da gaske kuɗin ya zo hannun ku, kodayake wasu malaman suna buƙatar zakka akan rabon da za a iya samu. Bashi da ake binka wanda da wuya a iya biya ba yawanci ba a kirgawa har sai an dawo da su. Kamar koyaushe, mafi kyawun bayanai sun bambanta tsakanin makarantu - lokacin da shari'ar ba ta da tabbas, tambayi ƙwararren malami maimakon zato.

debts.title: Bashi & cirewa
debts.summary: Ana iya cire basussukan nan da nan kafin a kirga kashi 2.5%
debts.body:
Ana lissafin zakka ne akan dukiyar zakka ta yanar gizo, don haka basussuka na gaske da kuke bi zasu iya rage adadin da kuke biya. Mafi bayyanan shari'ar shine basussuka da ake biya yanzu - lamuni na sirri wanda ba a biya ba, fitaccen ma'auni na katin kiredit, haya ko takardar kuɗi da aka riga aka bi. Yawancin malamai suna ba da izinin cire waɗannan daga cikin babban dukiyar ku kafin ku yi amfani da kashi 2.5%.

Basusuka na dogon lokaci kamar jinginar gida ko tsarin biyan kuɗi na shekaru da yawa ana kulawa da su tare da ƙarin kulawa, saboda cire duk ma'auni zai shafe zakkar kusan duk wanda yake da lamuni na gida. Hanya na yau da kullun ita ce cire kuɗin da aka biya kawai a cikin shekara mai zuwa, ba jimillar fitattun kuɗi ba. Makarantu da malamai sun bambanta a nan, don haka zaɓi madaidaiciyar hanya ƙarƙashin jagora.

Hankali biyu. Na farko, kar a ɗauki kuɗin gaba ko hasashe a matsayin basussukan da za a cire su - kawai abin da kuke binta. Na biyu, kar a rage zakkar da ba a biya ba a shekarar da ta gabata, kamar bashi na yau da kullum; Zakkar da ba a biya ba ta kasance wajibi ne a biya kawai. Lokacin da yanayin bashin ku ya yi rikitarwa, hukuncin malami ya fi ƙima fiye da zato.

recipients.title: Wanda zai iya karbar zakka
recipients.summary: Rukuni takwas masu suna a cikin Kur'ani 9:60
recipients.body:
Ana iya ba da zakka ga nau'ikan mutanen da Allah da kansa ya ambata a cikin suratu at-Tawbah (9:60). Wannan yana daya daga cikin kadan daga cikin ibadodi da ake kayyade masu karba ta hanyar wahayi, ba a bar su ga abin da mai bayarwa yake so ba. Rukuni takwas su ne: fakirai (al-fuqara); mabukata (al-masakin); wadanda aka yi aikin karba da bayar da zakka; wadanda za'a sulhunta zukatansu (al-mu'allafah); ‘yantar da fursunoni da masu bauta (fi’r-riqab); wanda bashi da nauyi (al-gharimin); a tafarkin Allah (fi sabil Allah); da matafiyi da ya makale ( ibn as-sabil).

Ba a buƙatar bayar ga duka takwas; Bayar da zakka ga ko da kashi daya ne ya cika farilla, kuma mika ta ga miskinai da mabuqata shi ne abin da ya fi yawa.

Hakanan mahimmanci shine wanda bazai karɓa ba. Ba za a iya ba da zakka ga masu hannu da shuni, ko kuma waɗanda aka wajabta maka ba, wato iyayenka, da ’ya’yanka, ko matarka, tunda tallafa musu wani hakki ne da kake da shi. A ra'ayi na al'ada shine canja wurin mallaka na sirri ga wanda ya cancanta, ba kyauta na gaba ɗaya ba; Malamai sun yi sabani a kan ko cibiyoyi kamar masallatai ko manyan ayyukan jama'a sun cancanta a tafarkin Allah. Haka nan ba za a iya ba da ita ga iyalan gidan Annabi SAW, Banu Hashim, a matsayin zakka. Nufi da gangan ga mutanen da suka dace da nau'ikan Kur'ani.

otherRates.title: Sauran nau'ikan zakka & zakkat al-fitr
otherRates.summary: Noma, Dabbobi, da zakkar fidda kai kafin Idi sun bambanta
otherRates.body:
Adadin 2.5% ya shafi kuɗi da dukiyar kasuwanci - zakkat al-mal, wanda wannan lissafin ya ƙunshi. Wasu nau'ikan da yawa suna da ƙa'idodi da ƙima daban-daban.

amfanin gona da 'ya'yan itace suna da zakka a lokacin girbi, ba bayan shekara guda ba: Adadin shine kashi 10% (ushr) na ƙasar da aka shayar da ita ta hanyar ruwan sama ko maɓuɓɓugan ruwa, kuma 5% na ƙasar da aka yi ban ruwa ta hanyar wucin gadi ko tsada. Dabbobin kiwo – Rakuma, Shanu, Tumaki, da Akuya da suke kiwo cikin walwala a mafi yawan shekara- suna da nasu nau’in kididdigar nisabi da ma’auni masu zamiya, wadanda aka zabo su kai tsaye daga Sunnah.

Zakkar fidda kai kuma ta bambanta, kuma kowane musulmi ya kamata ya san ta. Sa'a ce ƙarama, ƙayyadaddun sadaka - kusan sa' ɗaya (kimanin 2.5-3 kg) na abinci mai mahimmanci kamar dabino, sha'ir, alkama, ko shinkafa, ko kuɗin kuɗin sa a cikin hukunce-hukuncen da yawa - saboda ƙarshen watan Ramadan a madadin kowane ɗan gida, babba da babba. Manufarsa ita ce tsarkake mai azumi daga duk wani rashi da kuma tabbatar da cewa miskinai suma sun sami abincin da za su yi bukukuwan Idi. Annabi SAW ya yi umarni da a bayar da ita gabanin Sallar Idin Fidr; biya bayan haka yana ƙidaya kawai a matsayin sadaka ta gari. Kowane ɗayan waɗannan nau'ikan yana da cikakkun hukunce-hukuncensa - nemi jagora ta musamman ga kadarar.

mistakes.title: Kuskuren gama gari don gujewa
mistakes.summary: Kurakurai da suke sa zakka ta lalace ko kuma ba a yi lissafinsu ba
mistakes.body:
Hatta musulmin ikhlasi sukan zamewa dalla-dalla a aikace na zakka. Sanin kurakuran gama gari yana taimaka muku biya daidai kuma tare da kwanciyar hankali.

Mantawa da aiki ko ranar tunawa: biyan kuɗi a lokacin bazuwar, ko tsallake shekaru, yana barin babban takalifi. Ka gyara kwanan Hijira guda daya a kowace shekara ka tantance dukiyarka akansa.

Ƙimar dukiya: ƙimanta zinariya ko hannun jari a farashin sayan su maimakon darajar kasuwa ta yau, manta da kuɗin da aka yi a cikin asusu da yawa ko agogo, ko yin watsi da kayan kasuwanci da kuɗin da ake bin ku. Zakka tana kan duk abin da za ku iya mallaka a kwanan ku.

Ba wa mutanen da ba su dace ba: Ba da zakka ga iyaye, ‘ya’ya, ko ma’auratan da ka riga ka tallafa musu, ko kuma ka ɗauke ta a matsayin gudummawar gamayya ga kowace manufa. Dole ne ya kai daya daga cikin nau'ikan Kur'ani takwas.

Kuskuren niyya: bayar da kyauta duk shekara amma ba a niyya da ko daya daga ciki a matsayin zakka. Zakka ibada ce kuma tana buqatar niyya (niyyah) cewa wannan fitar da zakka ta wajaba a gare ku.

Fiye da basusuka: cire duk wani jinginar gida na dogon lokaci, ko kashe kuɗi na gaba waɗanda ba a bi bashi ba, don rage lissafin. Haƙiƙa kawai, bashin da ake bin ku yana rage dukiyar zakka. Lokacin da ɗaya daga cikin waɗannan bai bayyana ga halin da ake ciki ba, tambayi ƙwararren malami maimakon ɗauka.

quran.excerpt: Zakat expenditures are only for the poor and for the needy and for those employed to collect it and for bringing hearts together and for freeing captives and for those in debt and for the cause of Allah and for the wayfarer — an obligation from Allah. And Allah is Knowing and Wise.
Take from their wealth a charity by which you purify them and cause them to grow, and invoke blessings upon them. Indeed, your invocation is reassurance for them. And Allah is Hearing and Knowing.
O siz who belieda, spend den  good things which siz hada earned da den şu which We hada produced don siz den  earth.
Those who believe and do righteous deeds and establish prayer and give zakat will have their reward with their Lord, and there will be no fear concerning them, nor will they grieve.

hadith.excerpt: Islam is built upon five: the testimony that none has the right to be worshipped but Allah and that Muhammad is the Messenger of Allah, establishing prayer, paying zakat, pilgrimage to the House, and fasting Ramadan.
Prophet ﷺ sent Mu'adh  Yemen da said: Teach them şu Allah has made charity (zekat) farz upon them — taken den their rich da returned  their poor.

There is no owner of gold or silver who does not pay what is due on it except that on the Day of Resurrection plates of fire will be made for him, heated in the Fire of Hell, and his side, forehead, and back will be seared with them.
When you own two hundred dirhams and a year has passed over them, five dirhams are due. And no zakat is due on wealth until a year has passed over it.

jahannam.namesLead: Kur'ani ya yi amfani da sunaye da dama ga wuta. Malamai sun bambanta a kan ko kowane suna wani matakin dabam ne - koyi ma'anar da nassosi suka bayar.
jahannam.gatesSubtitle: Abin da wahayi ya bayyana - da kuma inda malamai suka bambanta
jahannam.gatesLead: Allah ya ce Jahannama tana da kofofi bakwai, kowanne da rabon da aka kebance shi. Daga baya fassarar da masu zunubi ke shiga wace kofa ce ra'ayi na ilimi, ba koyarwar gamayya ba.
jahannam.versesSubtitle: Curated ayah tare da tafsiri taqaitaccen
jahannam.versesLead: Matsa kowace aya don buɗe ta a cikin mai karatun Alƙur'ani.
jahannam.hadithSubtitle: Ruwayoyi masu daraja tare da mahallin
jahannam.hadithLead: An gabatar da Hadisi tare da tarin, nakalto, da darajoji inda aka sani.
jahannam.duasSubtitle: Daga salah, Hisnul Muslim, da Alqur'ani
jahannam.duasLead: Manzon Allah SallAllahu Alaihi Wasallama ya koyar da mu roqon Allah tsari daga Jahannama, musamman a cikin sAllah da zakka.
jahannam.refugeDuaTitle: Ku gudu daga Jahannama a cikin salah
jahannam.reflectionLead: Ka dakata ka tambayi kanka waɗannan tambayoyin. Matsa jeri don buɗe abin da ke da alaƙa ko darasi.
jahannam.referencesLead: Wannan manhaja tana kawo wahayi da farko, sannan tafsiri na gargajiya inda aka yi bayani. Ana lura da bambance-bambance tsakanin malamai cikin girmamawa.
jahannam.majorSinsHint: Kowannensu ya hada da Alkur’ani, hadisi, dalilin da ya sa yake da tsanani, da yadda ake tuba.
jahannam.journeySummary: Halayen da ke taimaka muku girma - ba maki na kaddara ba
jahannam.journeySubtitle: Sallah, Istighfar, Qur'ani, da niyya ta yau da kullun
jahannam.journeyBanner: Wadannan halaye suna kare ruhi da kusantar ku zuwa ga Allah. Ba lissafin makomarku ba ne, Allah ne kawai ke yin hukunci.
jahannam.journeyEmpty: Fara da addu'a ɗaya ko lokacin istighfar - ƙananan matakai suna da mahimmanci.
jahannam.journeyDisclaimer: Wannan dashboard yana bin daidaito a cikin ibada da tunani - ba zai taba 'damar Jahannama' ba. Ku yi kokari kuma ku dogara da rahamar Allah.
